title: Kernel Dynamics under Path Entropy Maximization
summary: We propose a variational framework in which the kernel function k : X x X -> R, interpreted as the foundational object encoding what distinctions an agent can represent, is treated as a dynamical variable subject to path entropy maximization (Maximum Caliber, MaxCal). Each kernel defines a representational structure over which an information geometry on probability space may be analyzed; a trajectory through kernel space therefore corresponds to a trajectory through a family of effective geometries, making the optimization landscape endogenous to its own traversal.
